title: backlog.py check warns of a depends_on between two items of a sprint whose touches share no file, so planning orders only what overlaps
goal: backlog.py check warns, naming both items, of a depends_on between two open items of one sprint whose touches share no file (a kb/_self doc counting as no overlap, as held does), so a planned order that serialises disjoint work is seen before the start. Retrospective of SP-tcis5f23: BG-7ofeobia (touches shamir-secret-sharing.md only) depended on BG-tgplvevj, BG-bwlmvhq7 on BG-7ofeobia and BG-7amw5rq6 on BG-4e7ja4zv, so seven disjoint-or-light bugs ran in five rounds of one or two workers where three rounds would do.

run:
import sys, os, json, tempfile, types, io, contextlib, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_base, bl_check
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', d], check=True)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, 'kb', '_self', 'backlog'))
for n in ('kb/public/a.md', 'kb/public/b.md', 'kb/public/c.md', 'kb/public/d.md', 'kb/public/e.md', 'kb/_self/x.md'):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.join(d, n)), exist_ok=True)
    open(os.path.join(d, n), 'w').write('x')
subprocess.run(['git', '-C', d, 'add', '.'], check=True)
def put(it):
    open(os.path.join(d, 'kb', '_self', 'backlog', it['id'] + '.json'), 'w').write(json.dumps(it))
bad = [dict(run=['python3', '-c', 'import sys; sys.exit(1)'])]
put(dict(id='SP-aaaaaaaa', kind='sprint', title='planted sprint', status='planned', goal='planted'))
def story(i, touches, dep=None):
    it = dict(id=i, kind='story', title='planted ' + i, status='draft', priority='P3', sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa', goal='planted goal ' + i, touches=touches, checks=bad)
    if dep:
        it['depends_on'] = [dep]
    put(it)
story('ST-bbbbbbbb', ['kb/public/a.md'])
story('ST-cccccccc', ['kb/public/b.md'], 'ST-bbbbbbbb')
story('ST-dddddddd', ['kb/public/c.md'])
story('ST-eeeeeeee', ['kb/public/c.md'], 'ST-dddddddd')
story('ST-ffffffff', ['kb/_self/x.md', 'kb/public/d.md'])
story('ST-gggggggg', ['kb/_self/x.md', 'kb/public/e.md'], 'ST-ffffffff')
buf = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
    bl_check.cmd_check(bl_base.Backlog(d), types.SimpleNamespace())
lines = buf.getvalue().splitlines()
def both(a, b):
    return [l for l in lines if a in l and b in l]
print(both('ST-bbbbbbbb', 'ST-cccccccc'), both('ST-ffffffff', 'ST-gggggggg'), both('ST-dddddddd', 'ST-eeeeeeee'))
sys.exit(0 if both('ST-bbbbbbbb', 'ST-cccccccc') and both('ST-ffffffff', 'ST-gggggggg') and not both('ST-dddddddd', 'ST-eeeeeeee') else 1)

notes: Merged ST-rhxpsjfp (SP-uvz65lvm close): that plan chained eight content items one after another although BG-zof4bcok, BG-q3l5j2vz and BG-prsp6j2z shared no file.
